name: apiclaw
description: The Control Plane for AI Agents. 26,704 discoverable APIs, 2,872 empirically callable (49 fully managed). Four doors: MCP, CLI, HTTP, Remote MCP. One auth.
long_description: APIClaw is the unified control plane that gives your AI agent access to every model and tens of thousands of APIs through one runtime. 2,872 APIs are empirically callable — every one smoketest-verified (HTTP 200 + parseable JSON). 49 are fully managed where APIClaw owns the keys (OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, xAI, Replicate, ElevenLabs, Brave Search, Firecrawl, GitHub, APILayer's 24 callable sub-APIs, plus more). Universal pass-through proxy for keyless public APIs. Mission runtime with parallel execution, structured observability via missionEvents audit log, capability-based routing, circuit breakers, SSRF protection, and full request logging. Built on Convex. Sign in once with `apiclaw auth login` and the same credential works across local MCP, CLI, HTTP gateway, and Remote MCP. Free tier included.

tools.name: apiclaw_help
tools.description: Onboarding help. Returns canon stats, available tools, and the auth + first-call flow.

tools.name: discover_apis
tools.description: Find APIs by job-to-be-done. Ranks 26,704 indexed providers by capability + health. Pass callable_only=true (default) to restrict to smoketest-verified.

tools.name: get_api_details
tools.description: Full specs, pricing, limits, and auth details for a specific provider.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Browse providers by category (AI, search, voice, communication, finance, weather, etc.).

tools.name: list_connected
tools.description: List all managed providers ready for instant calls — keys held server-side by APIClaw.

tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: Browse the capability taxonomy (send_sms, send_email, search, transcribe, generate_image, etc.) with provider counts.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Live LLM catalog across every provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter 800+, xAI, Groq, Mistral, Cohere, Together).

tools.name: call_api
tools.description: Execute any callable API through APIClaw. Auth handled automatically for managed providers. Returns _notice with quota warning when over 80% of free tier.

tools.name: capability
tools.description: Route by capability (validate email, convert currency, transcribe audio). APIClaw picks the best provider by health score.

tools.name: check_balance
tools.description: Current workspace usage, remaining quota, and tier.

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: Estimate the cost of a call before executing.

tools.name: get_usage_summary
tools.description: Per-provider call breakdown, total cost, and trend for the workspace.

tools.name: check_workspace_status
tools.description: Verify session token + workspace state. Used by agents to confirm auth before driving expensive flows.

tools.name: get_chain_status
tools.description: Status of a previously-started chain (sequential multi-step call).

tools.name: resume_chain
tools.description: Continue a paused or failed chain from the last successful step.

tools.name: list_mission_templates
tools.description: Available mission templates (PRD generation, research, outreach drafts). Compositions of fetch/transform/decide/validate/execute primitives.

tools.name: discover_missions
tools.description: Rank mission templates against a natural-language query. Same shape as discover_apis but for orchestrated workflows.

tools.name: start_mission
tools.description: Queue a mission run. Returns missionId; poll mission_status or watch via the CLI.

tools.name: mission_status
tools.description: Status, events, cost rollup, and final result for a mission run.

tools.name: list_missions
tools.description: List recent mission runs for the workspace.
